executionOwner: Development team; claim ownership in issue 162 before service provisioning

configurationPreflight.input: Explicit TEST variables in process memory or the service secret manager; no secrets in this manifest, source, command arguments or logs.
configurationPreflight.scope: Configuration validation only; live identity, database permissions, RLS and browser behavior remain unverified until the actual services are connected.

deploymentSequence: Development team connects Vercel and Supabase using its authorized service access; select or create dedicated TEST resources without production credentials or data. This handoff is not permission for the preparing agent to sign in.
Verify actual provider project identities and distinct TEST/production Supabase refs before accepting any database or storage credential.
Apply the existing migrations to the empty TEST database, provision the least-privilege app role, and verify forced tenant RLS using the existing scripts.
Configure real TEST Auth, private TEST storage/backup buckets, a freshly generated workspace encryption key, disabled billing and mock AI. Do not configure real messaging providers.
Create synthetic TEST users and tenant memberships without sending invitations, plus a synthetic workspace and canonical case; preserve the existing auth and onboarding flow.

Map only the preflight's curated Web/API variables into dedicated Preview environments for the preview branch. Do not inherit settings from production projects or write provider-managed VERCEL metadata as project variables. Keep preflight TEST inputs scoped to the same Preview branch.
Verify product source equality against productSourceSha; build the exact frontend entry and API, without auth transforms, seed entrypoints, fake responses or memory repository overrides.

Use Vercel CLI --local-config with the dedicated Web/API config files and verified TEST project IDs; root directories remain apps/web and apps/api. Verify the selected config and actual Preview target in deployment evidence. Never use --prod or the Production target. Project build settings alone cannot override the existing repository vercel.json.

Deploy the API as Preview, inspect readiness and verify real TEST identity/data access, then deploy the Web as Preview with the explicit API origin and TEST Auth redirect allowlist. Do not claim full readiness while the existing data-loss email monitor is unconfigured.
Run the hosted desktop/mobile acceptance cases with no API response mocks, save screenshots and reduced network evidence, then provide the verified HTTPS /app URL.

requiredChecks: Real TEST sign-in, tenant membership, workspace load and logout through unchanged product controls.
Task create/edit/complete/local reopen/reload; do not invent a server reopen endpoint or promise cross-device reopen durability absent from the existing product.
Medication add with times/weekdays, edit, archive confirmation/cancellation and reload under existing API contracts.
Home health response and rendered state from the actual TEST database, without forcing the synthetic visual-CI score.
Direct links and refresh, Hebrew RTL, light/dark, maximum existing text scale, pointer targets and keyboard focus.
Navigate to settings, await the actual destination heading and verify the scoped visual class is removed.

Reject localhost, production and unapproved API/Auth destinations and secrets in URLs/logs. Permit required Auth/Authorization headers only to verified TEST origins, plus the unchanged public Google Fonts origins.
Recreate the TEST API instance and read previously created canonical IDs before reseeding; a browser reload alone is not proof of server persistence.

automaticGitDeployment.manualPreviewDeployment: development team verifies dedicated TEST projects/configuration using its authorized access before Preview deployment

readinessLimitation.reason: The existing production-mode API reports ready:false without DATA_LOSS_ALERT_EMAIL. Configuring that field requires the existing Resend/support configuration, intentionally absent from the TEST map.
readinessLimitation.requiredResolution: Verify an authorized TEST-only mail sink/provider and monitoring configuration, or disclose the exact readiness limitation before describing the environment as fully ready. No fake keys, suppressed readiness checks, production mail credentials or product gate changes.

rejectedShortcut.oldAuthTransform: Changes the external auth gate to local; excluded.
rejectedShortcut.oldMemoryApi: No durable persistence or separate real identities; canonical health endpoints require the database-backed API; excluded.
